description:
- Ensured all TPC-H and TPC-DS queries are generated with a tool-supported base dialect and ALWAYS normalized via SQLGlot to the platform target dialect.
- "Added `get_tpc_base_dialect(benchmark_name: str) -> str` to `PlatformAdapter` (default: `ansi`)."
- "Wired adapters to pass both `base_dialect` and `dialect` into benchmark query generation."
- "Updated TPC-DS and TPC-H benchmarks to:"
- Added unit tests covering adapter dialect forwarding and translation pass-through for both TPC-H and TPC-DS.
- Simplified the query flow and removed ad-hoc translation shortcuts in favor of the standardized SQLGlot path.
